live_measurements_2026_09_12.two_distinct_event_tables: clued_control.execution_events is what read_execution()->'events' returns and what the series_e / budget_sequence segments range over: 88 rows, max sequence 88. clued_control.events is the ROOT event table that read_root()->'events' returns: 5 rows. The root6 GENERATION_REGISTERED event goes into the latter, becoming root event 6 -- it never touches execution_events. An earlier draft of this note said sequence 89 would be the registration event; that was wrong about which table, and is corrected here.
live_measurements_2026_09_12.what_will_occupy_execution_event_89: the twentieth binding forward (runbook step 14), operation EXECUTION_BINDING_FORWARD_ACCEPTED. The new budget lands at 90, following the 84-forward/85-budget pattern of the previous cycle.
live_measurements_2026_09_12.why_the_89_boundary_is_safe: Both 89 and 90 are >= 89, so the new root6 segment catches the budget wherever it lands. The forward event at 89 is never examined by these segments at all: reserve_gate:52 iterates only events whose operation is BUDGET_RESERVED, and reserve_gate:70 iterates attempts. The narrowed segment >=64 and <89 still covers every existing root5-era budget, the highest being 85.
live_measurements_2026_09_12.controller_agreement: context.mjs:152 sets root6BudgetSequence=89 and generationForBudget(s)= s>=89 ? root6, so a budget at 90 resolves to root6 on both sides.

transaction_guards_added_after_round_11.why: Round 11 found two gaps in NW-01's guard set and told the implementer to write the corrected shape into CP-01 rather than patch NW-01 on the eve of running it. Both are here. CP-01 has less margin than NW-01: it replaces SECURITY DEFINER functions and pins ten window literals.

window_assertion.what_was_wrong: In NW-01 the inside-the-window check lived in the preflight and in the generator, but not in the transaction. Of sixteen guards it was the only one that flips with time, and the only one not fail-closed -- the fifteen that were pinned static state that essentially cannot change between preflight and apply. The priority was exactly inverted.
window_assertion.why_it_matters_more_here: CP-01 writes 2026-09-13T07:05:16Z into ten places. Run after that instant, it would install literals for a window already closed, into three enforcement functions.
window_assertion.placement: both the pre-block and the post-block

untouched_functions_assertion.what_was_wrong: NW-01 asserted the named trigger's state but never that it was the ONLY non-internal trigger, and its post-block did not re-verify the other seven tables. The CP-01 analogue: cp01.prohibited forbids CHANGING_ANY_OF_THE_OTHER_ELEVEN_CONTROL_PLANE_FUNCTIONS, but nothing in the transaction enforced it -- the prohibition was words in an approval, not a guard in the SQL.
untouched_functions_assertion.digest_definition: sha256 of the newline-joined 'signature=prosrc_sha256' lines for every clued_control function except the three CP-01 replaces, in signature order
untouched_functions_assertion.note: effective_execution_binding is inside this set and is also asserted individually before and after, so it is covered twice on purpose.
untouched_functions_assertion.placement: both the pre-block and the post-block
